record.bible_text: And Adam<WH0120> knew<WH03045><WTH8804><WH0853> Eve<WH02332> his wife<WH0802>; and she conceived<WH02029><WTH8799>, and bare<WH03205><WTH8799><WH0853> Cain<WH07014>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I have gotten<WH07069><WTH8804> a man<WH0376> from<WH0854> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>Cain: that is, Gotten, or, Acquired<Rf>
